name: Delivery Billing
office_task: When a delivery job is marked done, put its draft invoice in Xero at our own item prices, park what it cannot price, and send only once our rule or accounts person releases it.
systems_of_record: the job or dispatch system that issues the job_id (ServiceM8, Simpro, or a job sheet)

emits.write: One draft invoice in Xero per completed delivery job, reference job:<id> (and the stage under a building contract), every line a job line at the Xero Items rate read at draft time, with the book edition, the accepted quote id where there is one, and any signed variation acceptance attached.
emits.readback: The invoice is read back from the ledger by the job id and must return the same invoice id and external id (Xero GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/{InvoiceID}). No id back is not a write: it raises invoice.write_failed to the named owner and the run stops.

emits.write: The release on the invoice record, naming the owner who closed the awaiting-release exception or the rule (with its threshold) that owner set, then the send from Xero. Nothing parked is ever released or sent.
emits.readback: The invoice read back by job id shows status sent, the sent time, and released_by or released_by_rule, with the release before the send.

emits.write: A parked or waiting invoice as an exception on the job: the reason (not_in_pricebook, unsigned_variation, no_stage, write_failed) or awaiting_release, the job id, the invoice id, the codes with no rate, and exception_owner set to the person the business named for invoices.
emits.readback: The invoice read back by job id shows status parked with its park reason, and the exception desk returns the exception against the job id with its exception_owner; the next run reads it there and stops.

port_of.original_name: Create a QuickBooks invoice on a new Onfleet Task creation
